issue.title: Missing stropts.h is stopping the installation of  cURL
issue.body:
Hello,

Since glibc version 2.30, `stropts.h` has been removed. At the same time, this curl version should not require stropts.h to exist as described in the source code https://github.com/curl/curl/blob/28b5b1c20a7f38b079b8828d06423d4b7a3ed439/lib/if2ip.c#L46. 
```
/meta/MAVSDK/build/default/third_party/curl/curl/src/curl/lib/if2ip.c:47:12: fatal error: stropts.h: No such file or directory
   47 | #  include <stropts.h>
      |            ^~~~~~~~~~~
```
This is blocking the entire installation of MAVSDK on Arch Linux.

https://github.com/curl/curl/blob/curl-7_67_0/lib/if2ip.c#L46-L48
